command: python3 -m sprat.cli add-user analyst analyst && RID=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst requirement "Encrypt data at rest" --content "Personal data must be encrypted at rest" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && PID=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst policy "GDPR" --content "Regulation (EU) 2016/679" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && python3 -m sprat.cli link analyst "$RID" "$PID" && python3 -m sprat.cli history analyst "$RID"
